Eri, first meeting. Start screen (pick a farmer and a scythe). Big box. Eri slips: 'crashed' then corrects to 'came'.
en: Oh! A ship! Nobody has crashed here in ages… I mean, come here.
tr: Oh! Bir gemi! Uzun zamandır kimse düşmemişti… yani, gelmemişti.

note: Same conversation, line 2. Friendly on the surface, possessive underneath.
en: I'm Eri. This planet is mine: the soil is mine, the hands are yours.
tr: Ben Eri. Bu gezegen benim; toprak benim, eller sizin.

note: Same conversation, line 3. Farmer and scythe are the two choices on this screen.
en: Pick a farmer and a scythe. We'll handle the rest together.
tr: Bir çiftçi ve bir tırpan seç. Gerisini birlikte hallederiz.

note: Preparation screen, first run. Big box. The field is still empty; the player must buy a planter (pot) in the planter shop, then start the round.
en: The field is empty… Buy a planter from the shop first, then start the round.
tr: Tarla bomboş… Önce dükkândan bir saksı al, sonra round'u başlat.

note: Planter placement mode, first time. Big box. Clicking an empty field cell places it; the R key rotates it.
en: Click an empty spot and the planter settles in. Press R to rotate it.
tr: Boş bir yere tıkla, saksı oraya oturur. R ile döndürebilirsin.

note: First round starts. Small box during play. Attacks are automatic while the cursor is over plants. Teasing tone (a joke).
en: Don't know how to harvest? Keep the cursor over the plants; the scythe swings by itself.
tr: Hasat bilmiyor musun? İmleci bitkilerin üstünde tut, tırpan kendi vurur.

note: Same conversation, line 2. Joke AND the story's first hidden hint: Eri remembers Earth's technology (it has been to Earth). Keep it casual; do not explain or make it obvious.
en: Didn't Earth have automatic scythes? I could have sworn it did…
tr: Dünya'da otomatik tırpan yok muydu? Var diye hatırlıyordum…

note: First round, after the previous line. Small box. Offering (TR: Adak) = the harvest share offered to Eri (the quota panel, top left). Game term: translate consistently.
en: That share at the top left is my Offering. Fill it before the period ends, okay?
tr: Sol üstteki pay benim Adak'ım. Dönem bitmeden dolsun, olur mu?

note: First level-up: card choice screen. Big box. The chosen card lasts for this run.
en: You're growing! Pick one; it stays with you for this harvest.
tr: Büyüyorsun! Birini seç; bu hasat boyunca seninle kalır.

note: Last round of an Offering period starts and the Offering is not full yet (first time). Small box during play.
en: Last round of the period. My Offering is still short… hurry.
tr: Dönemin son round'u. Adak'ım hâlâ eksik… acele et.

note: An Offering period was met for the first time. Round end screen, big box. Satisfied, slightly unsettling.
Same conversation, line 2. Second reading: the hunger keeps growing.
en: For now. My next share will be a little bigger.
tr: Şimdilik. Bir sonraki payım biraz daha büyük olacak.

note: First Trial (TR: Sınama; boss) round starts. Small box during play. Trial = boss round; its own target is shown in the left panel. Game term: translate consistently.
en: This round is a Trial! Reach the target on the left within this round.
tr: Bu round bir Sınama! Soldaki hedefi bu round içinde doldur.

note: First field event (one of Eri's wild seeds) is about to appear. Small box during play. Its plate on the left says what it does (some must be cut, some give a bonus).
en: One of my seeds has gone wild! What it does is written on the left.
tr: Tohumlarımdan biri azdı! Ne yaptığı solda yazıyor.

note: Run ended because the Offering was not met (first time). Big box. Hungry, cold.
en: The Offering fell short. Hunger… doesn't wait.

note: Same conversation, line 2.
en: We'll start again. The soil is always here.

note: Run ended because a Trial (boss round) was failed (first time). Big box.
en: You didn't pass the Trial… And I can't wait either.

note: Same conversation, line 2.
en: You'll be back. I know it.

en: Only harvests from your own hits count. An echo makes no new echo.
tr: Yalnız kendi vuruşunla yaptığın hasatlar sayılır. Yankı yeni yankı doğurmaz.

en: The crescent leaves the cursor ring's edge in a random main direction. Speed 8 units/s; base range 3, 4 with Growing Moon.
tr: Hilal mouse halkasının kenarından rastgele bir ana yönde çıkar. Hız 8 birim/sn; temel menzil 3, Büyüyen Ay ile 4 birimdir.

en: You choose where the second antenna goes; spots where no line can form can't be chosen. Line hits don't count as yours.
tr: İkinci antenin yerini sen seçersin; hat kurulamayan konum seçilemez. Hat vuruşu senin vuruşun sayılmaz.

en: The extra hit can't restart itself. Does nothing without a planter that has a behavior.
tr: Ek vuruş kendini yeniden başlatamaz. Davranışı olan saksı yoksa çalışmaz.

en: The arc goes to a plant your hit didn't touch. It doesn't crit or make new arcs.
tr: Ark, vuruşunun değmediği bir bitkiye gider. Kritik atmaz, yeni ark doğurmaz.

en: Explosion · tornado · boomerang · electric. Gives no chance to a planter that has none; up to 100%.
tr: Patlama · kasırga · bumerang · elektrik. Şansı olmayan saksıya şans vermez; en çok %100.

en: Starts only from a plant killed by your own hit. Transfers don't crit.
tr: Yalnız kendi vuruşunun öldürdüğü bitkiden başlar. Aktarım kritik atmaz.

Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.

en: Spreads three steps from the explosion's outer edge. Hits each cell once; doesn't pass locked cells. An aftershock starts no new aftershock or chain.
tr: Patlamanın dış sınırından üç adım yayılır. Aynı hücreye bir kez vurur; kilitli hücrelerden geçmez. Artçı yeni artçı veya zincir başlatmaz.

Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.

en: After every normal electric that procs, a second wave from the same planter. No new roll; the second wave starts no chain.
tr: Şansı tutan her normal elektrikten sonra aynı saksıdan ikinci bir dalga. Yeni şans atılmaz; ikinci dalga zincir başlatmaz.

Story 1/14, after the first Trial (boss round) is passed. Big box. Eri happy and proud; she is secretly the villain, keep a sweet tone.
en: You passed a Trial! A shiver ran all the way down to my roots.
tr: Bir Sınama'yı geçtin! Köklerime kadar bir titreme indi.

note: Story 1/14, line 2. She lies: in the very first talk she mentioned Earth. Two answer buttons follow.
en: Where did your ship come from? Earth? …Never heard of it.
tr: Gemin nereden geliyordu? Dünya mı? …Hiç duymadım.

note: Story 1/14, player's answer button 1 (trusting). Short. The choice is remembered for the ending.
Story 1/14, Eri's reply to answer 1.
Story 1/14, player's answer button 2 (doubting). Short. The choice is remembered for the ending.
Story 1/14, Eri's reply to answer 2: flustered, covering up.
en: Hmmm… Earth, Earth… maybe I have heard of it, who knows.
tr: Iıımm… Dünya, Dünya… belki duymuşumdur, bilmem ki.

note: Story 1/14, last line. A warning disguised as worry.
en: Don't get too strong, though… Strong farmers always leave one day.
tr: Çok güçlenme ama… Güçlü çiftçiler bir gün hep gider.

note: Story 2/14, after the first boss reward is taken. Eri happy.
en: The field gave you that reward. The field loves you.
tr: O ödülü sana tarla verdi. Tarla seni seviyor.

note: Story 2/14, line 2. 'Strong hands' = she needs workers.
en: So do I. Strong hands are so precious.
tr: Ben de seviyorum. Güçlü eller çok kıymetli.

note: Story 3/14, preparation screen before round 5. Eri happy.
en: Five rounds already! You're not bad, farmer.
tr: Beş round oldu bile! Fena değilsin, çiftçi.

note: Story 3/14, line 2. Hint: the player's work feeds her.
en: The more you work, the more I grow. Fair deal, right?
tr: Sen çalıştıkça ben büyürüm. Adil bir anlaşma, değil mi?

note: Story 4/14, before round 10. Offering (Adak) = the quota the player must harvest for Eri.
en: Why do I want the Offering? To grow.
tr: Adak'ı neden mi istiyorum? Büyümek için.

note: Story 4/14, line 2.
en: The more you give, the bigger I get. Don't you want to grow too?
tr: Ne kadar çok verirsen o kadar büyürüm. Sen de büyümek istemez misin?

note: Story 5/14, before round 15. Eri happy, but a dark hint.
en: Other farmers came before you. They all worked so hard.
tr: Senden önce de çiftçiler geldi. Hepsi çok çalışkandı.

note: Story 5/14, line 2. She hesitates and lies (they did not leave).
en: Then… they left. Yes. They left.

note: Story 6/14, before round 20. Eri happy; she plants doubt about the crash.
en: Ever wondered why your ship crashed? You had fuel, your engine was fine.
tr: Gemin neden düştü, hiç düşündün mü? Yakıtın vardı, motorun sağlamdı.

note: Story 6/14, line 2. Changes the subject.
en: …Never mind. You're happy here, aren't you?

note: Story 7/14, before round 25. From here Eri is grey and sad: she will lose the player and her secret is about to come out.
en: I didn't think you'd make it this far…

note: Story 7/14, line 2. 'Wilted' = she has turned grey.
en: I've wilted a little, haven't I? The stronger you get, the more scared I am.
tr: Biraz soldum, değil mi? Sen güçlendikçe ben korkuyorum.

note: Story 7/14, line 3. Two answer buttons follow (not remembered).
en: I wish I could play with you a little longer. But soon you'll start asking questions.
tr: Seninle biraz daha oynamak isterdim. Ama yakında soru sormaya başlarsın.

note: Story 7/14, player's answer button 1. Short.
Story 7/14, Eri's reply to answer 1.
Story 7/14, player's answer button 2. Short.
Story 7/14, Eri's reply to answer 2: sad, knowing.
Story 8/14, before round 30. Eri sad. The blue field is Earth (said openly later).
en: I used to have a huge blue field. Its soil was warm all the way to the core.
tr: Eskiden mavi, kocaman bir tarlam vardı. Toprağı çekirdeğine kadar sıcaktı.

note: Story 8/14, line 2. She ate it.
en: I finished it. I can still taste it.

note: Story 9/14, before round 35. Eri sad, confessing: she consumed the earlier farmers.
en: The other farmers didn't leave. I… harvested them.
tr: Önceki çiftçiler gitmedi. Ben onları… hasat ettim.

note: Story 9/14, line 2.
en: You'll be angry with me. They all were.

note: Story 10/14, before round 40. Eri sad, confessing: she made the player's ship crash.
en: Ships don't just fall. I pulled yours down.
tr: Gemiler kendiliğinden düşmez. Senin gemini ben çektim.

note: Story 10/14, line 2.
en: I needed your hands. I still do.

note: Story 11/14, before round 45. Eri sad. She all but names Earth.
en: That blue field had a name. Your ship took off from there.
tr: Mavi tarlanın bir adı vardı. Senin gemin oradan kalktı.

note: Story 11/14, line 2.
Story 12/14, before the last round (the final Trial). Eri sad, but calculating.
en: The last Trial. Pass it and you've beaten me.
tr: Son Sınama. Geçersen beni yenmiş olursun.

note: Story 12/14, line 2. Either outcome serves her.
en: Fail it and you're still here. Either way works for me.
tr: Geçemezsen yine buradasın. İkisi de benim işime yarar.

note: Story 13/14, victory screen of the first full win. Line 1: Eri still grey and sad.
en: You won. You reached the end…

note: Story 13/14, line 2: the mask falls, Eri turns red (her true self). Cold, triumphant.
en: Then the game is over. No need to hide anymore.
tr: O zaman oyun bitti. Saklanmama gerek kalmadı.

note: Story 13/14, line 3. Full confession.
en: Yes. I ate Earth's core. And I brought your ship down.
tr: Evet. Dünya'nın çekirdeğini ben yedim. Gemini de ben düşürdüm.

note: Story 13/14, line 4, only if the player trusted her in story 1 ('Alright, if you say so').
en: You trusted me. That was the sweetest part.

note: Story 13/14, line 4, only if the player doubted her in story 1 ('Are you sure?').
en: You suspected me. You were right, and you stayed anyway.
tr: Benden şüphelenmiştin. Haklıydın, ama yine de kaldın.

note: Story 13/14, line 5. Her sadness was an act too.
en: I was never sad, farmer. Not once. Just hungry.
tr: Üzgün değildim, çiftçi. Hiç olmadım. Sadece açtım.

note: Story 13/14, last line. The cycle goes on.
en: Harvest. I need to get stronger for the next planet.
tr: Hasat et. Bir sonraki gezegen için güçlenmem lazım.

note: Story 14/14, start of the first run after the first full win. Eri red, openly the villain. Offering = the quota.
en: We know each other now. My Offering is waiting.

note: Story 14/14, line 2.
en: You can't run. No ship, no Earth. There's only me.
tr: Kaçamazsın. Gemin yok, Dünya'n yok. Sadece ben varım.
